verses.text: A psalm by David. The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit in the highest position in heaven until I make your enemies your footstool.”
The Lord will extend your powerful scepter from Zion. Rule your enemies who surround you.
Your people will volunteer when you call up your army. Your young people will come to you in holy splendor like dew in the early morning.

footnotes.text: Or “You have the dew of your youth.”

verses.text: The Lord has taken an oath and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever, in the way Melchizedek was a priest.”
The Lord is at your right side. He will crush kings on the day of his anger.
He will pass judgment on the nations and fill them with dead bodies. Throughout the earth he will crush their heads.
He will drink from the brook along the road. He will hold his head high.
